capabilities: Sends the active note (frontmatter removed, embeds expanded) to the Refinr server
Previews the proposed backlog of epics, stories and sub-tasks with readiness verdicts
Creates issues in Jira or OpenProject from the preview
Records created issues and verdicts in the note's refinr frontmatter property
Reassesses or validates stories awaiting a human decision
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux); mobile untested and not offered. No telemetry; requests go only to the configured Refinr server. API key kept in Obsidian SecretStorage, per device. Cannot tell apart two instances of the same tracker name; long operations cannot be cancelled.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn a note into a structured, agent-ready backlog of Epics, Stories and Sub-tasks created as issues in Jira or OpenProject.

relations.evidence: The plugin sends the note to your Refinr server
Turn the active note into an agent-ready backlog (Epics, Stories, Sub-tasks) in Jira or OpenProject, via Refinr.
Turn the active note into an agent-ready backlog (Epics, Stories, Sub-tasks) in Jira or OpenProject, via Refinr.

requires.name: Self-hosted Refinr server 1.3.0+ (1.4.0+ for full features)
Jira or OpenProject account (used by the Refinr server)
AI provider account for the Refinr server (not needed with a local model)

summary: Obsidian client for the self-hosted Refinr server that turns the active note into an agent-ready Epic/Story/Sub-task backlog in Jira or OpenProject.
